caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic vessel with a rounded body and a narrow base, rendered in shades of beige, tan, and light brown. The object has two spouts near the top—one angled and slightly wider, the other narrower and more upright. A curved handle arches from the shoulder of the vessel to connect at the rim between the two spouts. The vessel is centered within a lightly outlined rectangular border, and the background consists of an off-white or cream-colored plain surface with no additional details. The light and shadow on the vessel suggest a soft light source, giving the rounded surface a gentle gradient from light to dark. The drawing is signed at the bottom right inside the rectangle with the name "Michael Z. Miceli."
title: Pottery Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
